# Brand & Trademark — Get Goods Gratis (Free)

*A single reference for the brand: name, slogan, logo, and the intended web address, plus the marks to
protect. Prepared for counsel / brand review. Not legal advice — have your attorney confirm availability and
handle any trademark filings and the domain purchase. All marks are shown in black and white; every drawing
below is a USPTO-compliant filing image (grayscale JPEG, 250–944 px on each side, 350 DPI, under 5 MB), so an
attorney can lift it straight from this document to file.*

## Logo (design mark)

![Get Goods Gratis (Free) logo — "G-cubed" monogram, black-and-white USPTO drawing](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

*USPTO-compliant filing drawing: grayscale, 350 DPI, sized within USPTO limits (250–944 px on each side), under 5 MB. Filing-ready source file:
`Black and White Images/GGG-mark-BW-USPTO-900px-350dpi.jpg`. The vector source of the mark lives in the app code
(`gg-logo.svg` / `gg-logo-mark.svg`); the app favicon/app icons derive from the same mark.*

### Logo specification

- **Concept:** a "G³" (G-cubed) monogram — the three G's of **Get Goods Gratis** — set as a large serif **G**
  with a superscript **3**, inside a rounded square.
- **Shape:** rounded square (viewBox 100×100, corner radius ~16), a keyline border, and a thin inner frame.
- **Typeface in the mark:** Georgia (serif), bold, for the "G" and the "3".

## Slogan

![Where Global Goods Gather — slogan, black-and-white USPTO drawing](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

*USPTO-compliant filing drawing: grayscale, 350 DPI, sized within USPTO limits (250–944 px on each side), under 5 MB. Filing-ready source file:

### Slogan usage

- Present the slogan as **"Where Global Goods Gather"** (title case), typically beneath the wordmark.
- Today it appears in the site footer (under the wordmark) in the app UI. It is a **brand tagline**, not a claim
  about earnings, returns, or results — keep it descriptive of the marketplace, consistent with the platform's
  advertising-value (never revenue/ROI) compliance posture.

## Trademark & domain — for counsel

- **Marks to consider protecting:** the word mark **"Get Goods Gratis"**, the slogan **"Where Global Goods
  Gather"**, and the **"G³" logo** (design mark). Consider using **™** on first/prominent use now, and **®** only
  **after** a registration issues.
- **Drawings to file:** the black-and-white drawings shown above. They are USPTO-spec (grayscale, 250–944 px,
  350 DPI, under 5 MB); the filing-ready files are in the `Black and White Images` folder.
- **Clearance:** confirm the marks are available (USPTO / common-law search) and that the slogan and "Gratis"
  usage don't conflict before filing or heavy use.
- **Domain:** **getgoodsgratis.com** is the intended address — verify it's available and register it (a purchase;
  it can't be done from here). Consider grabbing close variants (`.co`, `.shop`, `.app`, and the
  `getgoodsgratis` handle on major platforms) to protect the brand.
- **Nothing here is filed or reserved yet** — this note just gathers the assets in one place for your attorney.
